options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: computer
options.description: The common name of the computer account to be created in the Active Directory domain. If not specified, defaults to the name of the Active Directory configuration.

options.name: directory_servers
options.description: A list of directory servers that will be used for lookups related to user authorization Accepted server formats are IP address and DNS name All specified servers must be registered to the domain appropriately in the array configured DNS and are only communicated with over the secure LDAP (LDAPS) protocol. If not specified, servers are resolved for the domain in DNS The specified list can have a maximum length of 1, or 3 for Purity 6.1.6 or higher. If more are provided only the first allowed coun

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: domain
options.description: The Active Directory domain to join

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: join_existing
options.description: If specified as I(true), the domain is searched for a pre-existing computer account to join to, and no new account will be created within the domain. The C(username) specified when joining a pre-existing account must have permissions to 'read all properties from' and 'reset the password of' the pre-existing account. C(join_ou) will be read from the pre-existing account and cannot be specified when joining to an existing account

options.name: join_ou
options.description: Distinguished name of organization unit in which the computer account should be created when joining the domain. e.g. OU=Arrays,OU=Storage. The B(DC=...) components can be omitted. If left empty, defaults to B(CN=Computers). Requires Purity//FA 6.1.8 or higher

options.name: kerberos_servers
options.description: A list of key distribution servers to use for Kerberos protocol Accepted server formats are IP address and DNS name All specified servers must be registered to the domain appropriately in the array configured DNS and are only communicated with over the secure LDAP (LDAPS) protocol. If not specified, servers are resolved for the domain in DNS. The specified list can have a maximum length of 1, or 3 for Purity 6.1.6 or higher. If more are provided only the first allowed count used.

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: local_only
options.description: Do a local-only delete of an active directory account

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the AD account

options.name: password
options.description: Password string for I(username)

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the AD sccount is deleted or not

options.name: tls
options.description: TLS mode for communication with domain controllers.

options.name: username
options.description: A user capable of creating a computer account within the domain
